articles.title: Rahul Gandhi meeting with President Murmu: Security heightened at Vijay Chowk
articles.description: Security arrangements have been heightened at Vijay Chowk in New Delhi ahead of Congress leader Rahul Gandhi’s meeting with President Droupadi Murmu. Security personnel have been deployed as preparations continue for the meeting.

articles.title: To counter CJP stir, ‘Lal Hit Janata Party’ stages protest in Delhi
articles.description: Around 200 individuals gathered at Janpath in Delhi to protest against the disrespect shown towards Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The demonstration was organized by the Lal Hit Janata Party, opposing the Cockroach Janata Party's upcoming protest at Jantar Mantar. Attendees emphasized that using abusive language against national figures is unacceptable and called for accountability.

articles.title: Student Union Polls Cancelled At 2 Bhadrak Colleges
articles.description: Bhubaneswar: Student union elections at two colleges in Odisha’s Bhadrak district have been cancelled due to security concerns and alleged indiscipline

articles.description: Officers said the Delhi Police intelligence unit anticipates that more than 50,000 people, including those from adjoining states, could gather in the city.

articles.title: File doesn't reach judge in time, Supreme Court adjourns hearing on Punjab appeal
articles.description: The Supreme Court has postponed the hearing on Punjab government's appeal concerning the CBI investigation into corruption allegations. Senior advocate Vikas Singh requested an interim order to prevent the CBI from taking any action based on the High Court's directive. Justice Dipankar Datta mentioned that the case file did not reach a judge in time for proper preparation.

articles.title: Trump Envoys Kushner And Witkoff to Meet Ukrainian Negotiators in Miami
articles.description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will meet Ukrainian negotiators and European officials in Miami on Friday to present “new ideas and proposals” to break the stalemate in the Russia-Ukraine war.

articles.title: Fifty years ago | India to regulate entry of Britons
articles.description: From The Hindu Archives, October 9, 1976: India will soon introduce the system of entry permits for visitors from such of those Commonwealth countries as have similar restrictions in regard to Indian citizens.

articles.title: CBI raid at Punjab CM camp office a BJP campaign tactic, says Mann; BJP says don’t give political colour to HC order
articles.description: Punjab CM Mann accuses BJP of using CBI raids as election tactic after HC orders probe; BJP denies politicizing the investigation.

articles.title: ‘Why The Silence On Oct 7?’: Abdul El-Sayed Walks Away From Reporter; Then Rips Trump
articles.description: Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed faced an awkward confrontation after a reporter repeatedly asked why he had not issued a statement marking the third anniversary of the October 7 attacks. The reporter pressed El-Sayed twice on the issue as cameras rolled. El-Sayed did not answer the question and walked away, leaving the October 7 challenge unanswered.

articles.title: Group of 42 ex-judges defends SIR, slams opposition attack on Election Commission
articles.description: A group of 42 retired judges has expressed concerns over criticism directed at the Election Commission. They stated these attacks serve vested political interests, compromising democratic integrity. The judges defended the EC's actions as essential to maintaining clean electoral rolls for fair elections. They urged political parties to present legit grievances formally, rather than delegitimizing the electoral process.
